acceptance.assertion: The catalog manifest declares immutable generation-specific detail descriptors, and each selected identity resolves only through the currently accepted manifest generation rather than an ambient or mutable path.

Every detail load is same-origin, document-root-contained and verified against manifest-declared byte length and SHA-256 before parsing; schema, identity, generation and path mismatches fail closed without replacing visible bootstrap data.

Selection generations prevent stale responses from updating a newer identity, failed promises are evicted for retry, and shard and detail caches have explicit bounded capacity with deterministic eviction behavior covered by tests.

Loading, ready, degraded, mismatch and retry states are visible and accessible without focus loss or duplicate announcements; network, integrity and schema failures preserve a usable compatible bootstrap view.

German and English presentation, direct links, browser history navigation and no-JavaScript output preserve the same canonical identity semantics and do not expose stale detail from a previous selection.

Contracts define measurable gates for bootstrap removal, including catalog and detail parity, supported-browser behavior, offline and failure fallback, performance budget, rollback artifact and production readback; passing the shadow path alone does not satisfy cutover.

Unit, contract, generated-surface and public browser tests pass on the exact reviewed head, including representative desktop, mobile and iPad emulation, 4x CPU evidence, retry and stale-response fault injection, and a separately identified physical-device proof requirement.

Closeout binds the complete diff and exact head to review evidence, green required CI, merge commit, deployed generation and public production readback, and explicitly distinguishes browser emulation from physical-device evidence.

approval.note: The implementation changes Commonworld runtime, generated shells, contracts and browser evidence. Keep the build-bound bootstrap as the visible fallback until every cutover gate is independently proven; do not infer permission to remove it from successful shadow reads.

goal: Extend the verified selected-shard shadow path into a generation-bound, integrity-checked detail loader with stale-response isolation, bounded caching, explicit degraded and retry states, multilingual and deep-link parity, and evidence-based cutover gates before any build-bound bootstrap data may be removed.

does_not_establish: permission to remove build-bound bootstrap data
automatic queue, claim, dispatch, merge or deployment authority
that every catalog detail is already available or generation-bound

rollback.strategy: Disable detail shadow loading and continue serving the existing build-bound bootstrap and selected-shard shadow path; retain generation artifacts and receipts for diagnosis without rewriting catalog history.

title: Deliver generation-bound catalog detail loading and cutover gates
